install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The project's own recipe (building from source) previously failed to serve a real HTML UI within the startup timeout. Switched to the project's official prebuilt Docker Hub image (sissbruecker/linkding) instead. The image's uWSGI server defaults to binding LD_SERVER_HOST='[::]' (IPv6), which crash-looped with 'socket(): Address family not supported by protocol' in this sandbox's IPv4-only Docker network - fixed via LD_SERVER_HOST=0.0.0.0 (the image's own documented env var). The admin account was provisioned directly at first boot via the image's own LD_SUPERUSER_NAME/LD_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD env vars, set to the pipeline's standard libwalker/Walker-Pass-2026! test credentials, so the standard screens.py crawler logged in and rendered the real (empty, fresh-install) Bookmarks dashboard on its own.
